source.check: every name and label checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1927: no contests. The Armagh Guardian says 18 nominations were received for the 31 seats and three were invalid (Ballymartrim, Wm. Anderson; Corporation West, John Loughran; Tynan, James Alexander Gray). Where no valid nomination was made the retiring councillor was deemed re-elected, but the paper does not name them. Returned unopposed.
